help.label: About gap analysis
help.title: How the gap lists are chosen
help.summary: Four lists over the keywords you track, each rule applied to the latest checks of your app and the competitors you track.
help.keywordGapsRule: A competitor ranks in the top {top} and you are unranked or below {below}.
help.winnableRule: A gap where difficulty is below popularity, or the best competitor ranks {from} or lower.
help.threatsRule: You rank in the top {top} and a competitor 1 to {within} places below you moved up on its last check, or passed you in the last {days} days.
help.leadRule: You are ahead of every competitor that ranks.
help.badge: The Gap badge of the comparison matrix uses stricter numbers on purpose: it marks only the keywords a competitor holds on the first page.
help.readMore: Read how the lists are chosen
